items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Now, was that union scale, or was that what Dwight paid? No, that was union scale.

ctx.x: Kind of, yeah, kind of standard. $15, well, $10 was the standard thing. See, at one time it was eight. I think it went up to ten, and I think I probably made fifteen.
Now, was that union scale, or was that what Dwight paid? No, that was union scale.
Eight dollars was union scale. And what, what assignment did you get it? Well, no, no, well, I made, well, if I made fifteen, the assignment must have got eight. Oh, okay. Or maybe ten.
